metadata.title: Doxorubicin 50 mg/m² and Docetaxel 75 mg/m² (AT 50/75)
metadata.indication: Locally advanced or metastatic breast carcinoma.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.source_version_verification_method: manual comparison with current official NCCP PDF header and version-control information
metadata.legacy_internal_id_note: Stable internal ID retained to avoid breaking existing bookmarks and catalogue references; display metadata now records the explicit NCCP source version.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled encoding · independent clinical and pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP source and boundary cases reviewed; not clinical validation or authorisation.

metadata.schedule_summary: Doxorubicin followed by docetaxel on Day 1 every 21 days, for up to six cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity changes the plan.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

action.recommendation: Previous anthracycline maximum is a source exclusion. Reconcile lifetime exposure across all previous treatments; do not add different anthracycline doses directly.

action.recommendation: Suspected current febrile neutropenia: withhold treatment and arrange urgent clinical assessment. This is not the previous-cycle dose-reduction pathway.

rules.explanation: Suspected current febrile neutropenia: withhold treatment and arrange urgent clinical assessment. This is not the previous-cycle dose-reduction pathway.

action.recommendation: Withhold and urgently assess new chest pain, breathlessness, palpitations or heart-failure symptoms; investigate before further anthracycline.

rules.explanation: Withhold and urgently assess new chest pain, breathlessness, palpitations or heart-failure symptoms; investigate before further anthracycline.

action.recommendation: Interpret current LVEF with baseline, symptoms, measurement trend and cardiovascular risk; a single number is not cardiac clearance. Arrange oncology/cardiology review where abnormal.

action.recommendation: Delay one week for ANC<1.5 or platelets<100; reassess before restarting.

action.recommendation: Baseline eligibility uses ANC>1.5 and platelets>100 whereas the treatment table uses≥. Clarify exact initiation boundaries before starting.

action.recommendation: LVEF<50% is an NCCP cardiac exclusion; do not initiate doxorubicin pending specialist review. During therapy assess cause and trend urgently.

rules.explanation: Bilirubin>85µmol/L: omit doxorubicin.

action.recommendation: Docetaxel table lists75 mg/m² in this hepatic pattern: that is already the AT starting dose, not a25% reduction. Check the severe hepatic row, bilirubin and current dose before prescribing.

rules.explanation: Docetaxel table lists75 mg/m² in this hepatic pattern: that is already the AT starting dose, not a25% reduction. Check the severe hepatic row, bilirubin and current dose before prescribing.

action.recommendation: Evaluate the full severe hepatic pattern in Table3: ALP>6×ULN and/or AST and ALT>3.5×ULN, with bilirubin>ULN. Stop docetaxel unless strictly indicated by consultant. A single abnormality does not establish the complete table pattern; obtain missing values and resolve the AND/OR wording. No automatic dose.

rules.explanation: Evaluate the full severe hepatic pattern in Table3: ALP>6×ULN and/or AST and ALT>3.5×ULN, with bilirubin>ULN. Stop docetaxel unless strictly indicated by consultant. A single abnormality does not establish the complete table pattern; obtain missing values and resolve the AND/OR wording. No automatic dose.

action.recommendation: Severe docetaxel hepatic pattern meets the printed stop criterion. Stop unless strictly indicated following explicit consultant decision.

rules.explanation: Severe docetaxel hepatic pattern meets the printed stop criterion. Stop unless strictly indicated following explicit consultant decision.

action.recommendation: Grade 3 skin reaction, neuropathy>grade 2 or grade 3/4 stomatitis: source reduces docetaxel to60 mg/m². If the relevant toxicity persists at 60 mg/m² discontinue; establish current dose and persistence before restart.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 skin reaction, neuropathy>grade 2 or grade 3/4 stomatitis: source reduces docetaxel to60 mg/m². If the relevant toxicity persists at 60 mg/m² discontinue; establish current dose and persistence before restart.

action.recommendation: Relevant source toxicity persists at docetaxel60 mg/m²: discontinue docetaxel.

rules.explanation: Relevant source toxicity persists at docetaxel60 mg/m²: discontinue docetaxel.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 skin toxicity: withhold and urgently review. The printed grade 3 reduction must not be automatically applied to grade 4.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 skin toxicity: withhold and urgently review. The printed grade 3 reduction must not be automatically applied to grade 4.

action.recommendation: Severe hypersensitivity: stop docetaxel, provide emergency management and do not rechallenge.

rules.explanation: Severe hypersensitivity: stop docetaxel, provide emergency management and do not rechallenge.

action.recommendation: Verify dexamethasone8 mg twice daily for 3 days starting the day before docetaxel, minimum3doses before infusion. Missed doses need a consultant-selected rescue plan; reconcile with antiemetic steroid to avoid duplication.

rules.explanation: Verify dexamethasone8 mg twice daily for 3 days starting the day before docetaxel, minimum3doses before infusion. Missed doses need a consultant-selected rescue plan; reconcile with antiemetic steroid to avoid duplication.
